mentions.name: TaggedSync
mentions.description: An Obsidian plugin that converts handwritten reMarkable tablet notes into searchable text, with handwriting recognition that can run locally on a Mac. It also sends highlights and margin notes from the tablet to Readwise.
mentions.source_excerpt: An Obsidian plugin that turns handwritten reMarkable notes into searchable text. You can run the handwriting recognition locally on a Mac. The latest feature I added sends your highlights and margin notes from the tablet to Readwise. https://taggedsync.com
mentions.author: vodaza36
